text: This is the Vivienne from Velantra.
It's soft vegetable tanned leather with
aged brass hardware, a shoulder strap
and there's no logo anywhere on
it, so nobody can tell what you paid.
It looks like the bag the
woman with the corner office carries,
and it holds her whole day,
They're running a pre-order sale on
it right now, it ships in
October, and the colors do sell out.
Stop walking in with the cheap one.
